revision_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: revised square Don't Starve Together mod icon.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing icon to edit. Image 2 is an official DST loading-screen illustration from the installed game; the small orange shaggy dog at the upper left (above the gray kitten and left of the large orange bird) is the native Vargling character reference for Publilius. Image 3 is the native fire-hound sprite atlas from the installed game, a color/shape/linework reference for Lupa; its separated pieces are not the desired layout.
Primary request: Replace ONLY the two generic wolf designs in image 1 with unmistakably native Don't Starve Together creature designs: Lupa must be the game's FIRE HOUND / RED HOUND, and Publilius must be the game's default VARGLING (critter_puppy / pupington), based on image 2. Preserve the scroll, golden bell, dark brown textured background, compact square icon composition, affectionate reunion, and scratchy ink storybook treatment.
Lupa: a true DST fire hound with a hunched compact shaggy dark burgundy/rust-red body, an oversized long low broad grotesque snout and jaw, jagged ivory triangular teeth along the mouth, tiny pale eyes high on the head, a purple-dark nose and little purple tongue, short angular ears tucked into the head fur, skinny scruffy legs with little clawed feet, and a short thin curved tail. Use the angular scruffy red fur shapes, burgundy and black hatching, purple details visible in image 3. She is not on fire; she is caring for her pup. Make her face and silhouette recognizably the DST hound enemy adapted into a protective maternal pose. Do not give her tall fox ears, a pointed fox muzzle, a long elegant neck, cream chest mane, or a big bushy fox/wolf tail.
Publilius: the actual default Vargling in image 2's upper left: tiny round/bean-shaped squat fluffy orange-tan puppy with a shaggy silhouette, stubby paws, tiny triangular upright ears, huge pale oval eyes, a very oversized rounded reddish-purple dog nose, a broad muzzle with two protruding little ivory fangs, and a pink-purple tongue; draw him looking fondly up at Lupa. Keep his recognizable large nose, wide-eyed face and orange woolly round body. Not a realistic wolf pup, not a fox cub, not a Varglet, and no alternate pet skin.
Composition: Lupa remains the large protective figure on the left and around the smaller Vargling in the center, with their snouts visibly distinct. Adjust the body positions as needed for native hound anatomy rather than keeping the original long fluffy tail. Keep the parchment scroll behind them and gold bell at the bottom clearly visible. Subjects fill frame but all ears and paws stay inside.
Constraints: same square aspect, no text or lettering, no other animals, no collars, no costume, no new props, no interface, no watermark. Faithful actual DST creature anatomy with hand-inked rough outlines, muted earth colors, bold readable thumbnail silhouettes. Keep the background opaque.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square illustrated mod icon for Don't Starve Together, readable at 128 by 128 pixels.
Primary request: An original icon for a Latin adventure playscript mod about rescuing Lupa, a beloved she-wolf, from a cruel king and reuniting her with her puppy Publilius.
Subject and composition: A large affectionate but wild red-orange she-wolf hound with pointed ears, shaggy angular fur, a long dark muzzle, expressive pale eyes, and a small tooth, curled protectively around one small wolf puppy. The mother hound and puppy dominate the center, with clearly distinct, strong silhouettes. Behind them is one curled aged parchment scroll representing the Latin playscript, with only a few abstract ink strokes, no readable writing. At the bottom foreground sits one small antique golden handbell with a curved handle, a key magical story object. Keep the bell simple and recognizable. This is a compact illustrated emblem, not a detailed landscape or a collage.
Style/medium: Match the hand-drawn storybook artwork of Don't Starve Together: scratchy black pen outlines of uneven weight, crooked angular shapes, slightly macabre yet tender whimsy, flat muted earthy fills, sparse etched hatching, distressed paper texture. The mother hound should feel like a friendly DST fire hound, never realistic or a smooth cartoon mascot. Warm rust-red fur, parchment ivory, tarnished ochre bell, charcoal shadows; desaturated warm dark brown background. High figure/background separation.
Composition/framing: square 1:1, centered emblem filling most of frame with a little breathing room, all ears, scroll ends, and bell fully inside frame. Bold broad shapes with minimal fine detail, suitable for a small mod-list thumbnail. Full-bleed subtly textured dark background, no border.
Constraints: no typography, no readable text, no letters, no title, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no photorealism, no 3D, no glossy gradients, no extra limbs, no extra animals.
